description: List episodes for a specific show. Use 'fields' to request only specific attributes and reduce response size (e.g. {"episode": ["title", "number", "status", "season"]}). Use 'query' to search by title.

fields.description: Sparse fieldsets to reduce response size. Keys are resource types (e.g. 'episode'), values are arrays of field names (e.g. ['title', 'number', 'status', 'season', 'transcript_url'])

order.description: Sort order: 'desc' (newest first, default) or 'asc' (oldest first)

show_id.description: ID of the show to list episodes for

name: list_episodes
